summary: An RTCP Canonical Name is a persistent identifier for an RTP endpoint, staying the same even when its SSRC changes. This standards-track document gives guidelines for choosing CNAMEs so that they are unique and keep working. It was replaced by RFC 7022.

eli5.summary: On a video call, your temporary number might change, but your name tag stays. This advises how to make name tags that don't clash. It was later replaced by RFC 7022.

questions: how to choose rtp canonical name
